packages.name: MIO Web Server (MIOWS)
packages.summary: Production-grade HTTP/1.1 and WebSockets for YottaDB.
packages.description:
MIOWS is a fast, stable web server written in M.
It supports HTTP routing and WebSockets.
It includes JSON, templates, metrics, audit logging, auth middleware, and GA test tooling.
packages.install:
git clone <repo>
# Load routines into YottaDB
# Start with: yottadb -run start^MIO

packages.name: MIO JSON (MIOJSON)
packages.summary: Pure M JSON encode and decode routines.
packages.description:
MIOJSON implements JSON encoding and decoding.
It is designed for correctness and stability.
It is used by MIOWS for APIs and tooling.
packages.install:
Included with MIOWS.
Call JSON routines directly.
See docs for entry points.

packages.name: MIO Templates (MIOTPL)
packages.summary: Server-side templates with layouts, partials, and caching.
packages.description:
MIOTPL renders HTML templates.
It supports layouts, partials, and safe escaping.
It supports caching and development watchers.
packages.install:
Included with MIOWS.
Place templates under templates/.
Render with RENDERPAGE^MIOTPL.

packages.name: MIO Auth Middleware
packages.summary: Auth middleware with JWT, JWKS hardening, and RBAC/ABAC.
packages.description:
Middleware for protected APIs.
Includes JWT verification and JWK refresh hardening.
Supports RBAC and ABAC route policies.
packages.install:
Included with MIOWS.
Enable auth middleware in config.
See auth docs.

packages.name: MIO Metrics (Prometheus)
packages.summary: Prometheus metrics endpoint and alert-ready counters.
packages.description:
Exports metrics for HTTP and WebSocket traffic.
Provides counters and histograms for operations.
Works with alert rules and dashboards.
packages.install:
Included with MIOWS.
Scrape /metrics.
See operations docs.
